stem.en: The position-time graphs of four objects A, B, C and D moving along a straight line are shown. On which object does a net force act?

feedback.en: A straight rising line means a constant velocity. No net force acts on A.
A flat line means B stays at rest. No net force acts on B.
Right. The curve gets steeper, so the velocity of C keeps increasing. A net force acts on it.
A straight falling line means a constant velocity in the negative direction. No net force acts on D.

explanation.en: A net force changes the velocity. The graphs of A and D are straight lines (constant velocity), and B is flat (at rest). Only the graph of C curves, so only the velocity of C changes.

hints.en: Which graph shows a velocity that changes?
